name: Orb Frenzy 3D
tagline: Drop orbs. Merge them. Grow the frenzy.
description: A physics merge puzzle built in Unity and rendered straight from the WebGL player: glossy faceted orbs with faces, real light, and a container that answers every drop. Pick your column, drop an orb, and identical tiers fuse on contact into the next orb up - eleven tiers from a tiny Spark Orb to a white-hot Infinity Orb. A fuse that sets off another fuse scores a chain, and chains are where the score really comes from. Merge two Infinity Orbs and the whole board goes up in a Cosmic Burst. The container only holds so much, so every drop is a bet on where the stack is going; when the pile breaches the line, the run ends. Progress - best score, best chain, highest tier reached, runs played - saves locally, and follows you between devices when you sign in with a Little Joy Arcade account.
highlights: Native Unity WebGL build with real 3D orbs, not sprites standing in for them
Eleven tiers, each a distinct hue - Spark, Pebble, Glow, Pulse, Prism, Nova, Radiant, Comet, Titan, Celestial, Infinity
Orbs with faces: they blink, wobble and react to what is happening in the container
Chain reactions score a multiplier, and two Infinity Orbs set off a Cosmic Burst
Physics-driven stacking: every drop lands differently, so the board is never the same twice
Playfield reframes itself to any canvas, portrait or landscape
Progress saves locally and syncs to your Little Joy Arcade account, and plays offline without one
howToPlay: Open the game and wait for the Unity progress bar - the first load streams the whole player
Move left and right to choose the column, then drop: the orb falls and settles on the stack
Land two orbs of the same tier touching and they fuse into the next tier up - bigger orb, more points
A fuse that triggers another fuse scores a chain. Set off a long chain and the multiplier climbs fast
Keep the stack under the danger line - if the container overflows, the run is over
Chase two Infinity Orbs into each other for a Cosmic Burst
